verdict.rationale: Otter documents several background automations — scheduling the AI Notetaker to auto-join recurring Zoom/Teams/Meet calls, auto-extracting action items and syncing them to CRMs/Jira/Asana/Zendesk, and webhooks/API for custom triggers — which run without manual intervention once configured. However, there's no evidence of a dedicated automation/workflow builder with conditional logic, multi-step agent chains, or a way to author custom autonomous routines beyond these fixed integrations. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/rules engine, evidence of conditional/multi-step autonomous workflows, and independent confirmation these automations run reliably unattended.
